summary: An on/off switch for a setting, with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and its accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner control.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Only when other visible text in the row names the setting.

description.note: Help text under the label, read as the accessible description.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and blocks form submission (customError).

value.note: Submitted under name while on; nothing is submitted while off.

checked.note: On or off. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Must be on to submit (valueMissing). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Cannot be focused or toggled; dimmed; not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor has the same effect without changing this attribute.

size.note: Track 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm); the label text keeps its size.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: the switch in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The track: pill-shaped, filled by the state; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, covering the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob; at the start edge when off, the end edge when on. Its position carries the state without color.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle by the person. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed by the person; not fired when checked is set from code. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed. Form value is already updated when it fires.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end edge (the start edge in right-to-left). The thumb slides over switch.transition-duration; under prefers-reduced-motion it moves without a transition.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt
invalid.note: The off track takes the destructive color; an on track keeps its fill, the error text and aria-invalid carry the state.

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor
disabled.note: Track and label dimmed; not-allowed cursor.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: submits value under name only while on; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing, error -> customError); form reset restores the checked attribute; restored form state sets checked; a disabled fieldset disables it without touching the disabled attribute and it is then not submitted; a <label for> pointing at the host toggles it.

accessibility.targetSize: Track 32x20 (default) or 24x16 (sm); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Shift+Tab: move focus to the previous focusable element
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission, like Checkbox and Input; the inner control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). Does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; checked state exposed natively as aria-checked true/false
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
no mixed state: a switch is only on or off
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
toggling announces on/off through the native switch role

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off, such as a preference
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label that names the setting, not the action

useCases.when: The setting needs its effect or consequence explained
A dense list of settings, such as a table row or a compact panel
A server or validation rejects the setting
The setting must be on before the form can be sent
useCases.use: required with a label that states the condition

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing several items from a list, or agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as a setting with an immediate effect; a selection or agreement is a choice recorded on submit

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing one of more than two options
antiPatterns.why: A switch has exactly two states

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state ("On"/"Off") or names the action ("Turn on")
antiPatterns.why: The role already announces on/off; a changing name is read as a different control
antiPatterns.alternative: A stable label naming the setting ("Airplane mode")

antiPatterns.pattern: A toolbar button that stays pressed (bold, mute)
antiPatterns.why: That is a pressed button, not a setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn uses 18.4px / 14px; rounded to the spacing grid
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern (checkbox-based); look and sizes from the visual reference; label row beside the switch like Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch> or a <button role=switch> with aria-checked?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and taken: the native checkbox with role=switch (SB-0007 native first). It brings Space, required/valueMissing, the validation message and form-reset semantics for free and reuses FormAssociated + NativeControl like Checkbox; a button would re-implement all of it.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG lists it as optional)?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and taken: no. Enter submits the form, like the native checkbox, Checkbox and Input (SB-0009); toggling with Enter would break implicit submission in settings forms.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and how are they named?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and taken: two sizes, default and sm (the global size alias maps them to medium and small), as in the visual reference. Dimensions come from the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens (32x20 and 24x16), thumb 16 and 12 with a 2px inset. No lg: nothing asks for it.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and where does it sit?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and taken: required (like Checkbox and Input), with hide-label to keep it as the name only. The label sits after the switch (inline-end), description and error under the label.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and taken: no, as Checkbox. The attribute is the default that form reset restores (native defaultChecked).

openQuestions.question: How does invalid look on a switch that is on?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and taken: the off track turns destructive; an on track keeps the primary fill so the state stays legible, and the error text and aria-invalid carry the invalid state (color is never the only signal, WCAG 1.4.1).
